instruction: Run a backup service every day at 02:30 using a timer.
output:
# backup.service
[Unit]
Description=Daily backup

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/backup.sh

# backup.timer
[Unit]
Description=Run backup daily

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 02:30:00
Persistent=true

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
